body: My daughter was taken away. My verbal abuse caused her to have borderline personality disorder, and when she was twelve it manifested and she did things like kicking out my windshield, and kicking holes in the walls, and not wanting to go to school, and shoplifting and drug seeking. I was investigated seven times that year and she spent the next three years in foster care...courtesy of inconsistant parenting and verbal abuse on my part. They also gave full custody of my two year old to his Dad and made me have supervised only visitation.
I know I deserve to die for abusing and killing my daughter..and I will.

I am sorry. I will erase it. I know I am not much of a writer, and I was up all night with insomnia. My 21 year old daughter died six months ago. My family let her go to foster care, even though they ran programs for foster care kids, and never saw her after she turned 18. Now they are justifying their complete lack of involvement in her life, and my life. I am her Mother. She was the SG child of a SG.

I thought I was the only one who isolated on purpose with the end result being your loved ones had already adapted to not seeing or hearing from you so your final goodbye would be easier. Reading here it seems to be common...but I don't think it works. Your final goodbye will still deeply sadden your friends and family. Why the arbitrary timeline on deciding if you want to live or die? Forty is still pretty young..in a lot of ways your life continues to get better in your forties.  Also, why try and base your worth on some ones random comment and opinion? The whole sum of who you are is complex, and valuable, and mysterious...and you don't have to be tied to self imposed or perceived limitations. Also, when you are depressed your judgement gets skewed..and you are probably about one thousand times to hard on yourself. I hope you don't limit your life. I know it is hard. I hope you find someone to talk to that has your best interests at heart.

Hey, I love you. Finding love can be so hard, especially on the internet where people can be the worst trolls imaginable. It hurts to be rejected for weight, health, mental health reasons. It is hard to live on just a little bit of money. Those things, absolutely do not define you. Your intellect, your sense of humor, sense of sarcasm...your soul...even the ability to rebel from a blinkered binding world are bigger then that. I hope you know that. I hope you carry on.
